claim: Among 150 adults with systolic blood pressure measured at three annual visits, those with a higher initial blood pressure have a lower yearly rate of change: the Pearson correlation between an individual's underlying yearly rate of change in systolic blood pressure and the individual's underlying initial systolic blood pressure is at most -0.30.

data_keys.meaning: systolic blood pressure of each individual at each of three annual visits, with the visits in time order, in mmHg

claim: Across 120 anaesthetised animals, tissues extract more oxygen when more is supplied: the Pearson correlation between the arterial-minus-mixed-venous oxygen content difference and the arterial oxygen content is at least 0.30.

data_keys.meaning: arterial blood oxygen content of each animal, in mL O2 per dL
a second, independent determination of the arterial blood oxygen content of each animal, in mL O2 per dL
mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each animal, in mL O2 per dL
a second, independent determination of the mixed-venous blood oxygen content of each animal, in mL O2 per dL

claim: A classifier built from the measured variables ranks new records correctly: the area under the ROC curve for the event is at least 0.75.

data_keys.meaning: measured variables of each record
True if the event occurred for the record

claim: On future days, a ridge regression forecast of the outcome y from the day's five predictors X (penalty 1.0 on standardised predictors, with an intercept, one model for all stations) has a squared error at least 5% below that of the persistence forecast (the previous day's outcome at the same station), with squared errors pooled over stations: 1 - MSE(model) / MSE(persistence) >= 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: 5 continuous daily predictors recorded at each station on each day
continuous daily outcome measured at each station

claim: The measurements in X carry information about the outcome y: the R-squared (coefficient of determination) of a ridge regression of y on X (penalty 1.0 on standardised measurements, with an intercept), evaluated on new samples, is at least 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: panel of 150 continuous biomarker measurements for each sample
continuous clinical score of each sample

claim: Across children, BMI at age 5 and the yearly rate of change in BMI between ages 5 and 10 are negatively correlated: the correlation between the two is at most -0.25.

data_keys.meaning: BMI of each child at the annual visits at ages 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 (visits in age order), in kg/m2

claim: Gene-expression profiles measured at diagnosis predict survival time in new patients: the out-of-sample R-squared for predicting survival_months from the expression profile is at least 0.10.

data_keys.meaning: log2 expression level of each gene in each patient's tumour sample
months from diagnosis to death, observed for every patient

claim: Within patients, oxygen consumption rises with oxygen delivery: the mean over patients of the within-patient slope of oxygen consumption on oxygen delivery is at least 0.1 mL/min per mL/min.

data_keys.meaning: cardiac output of each patient at each measurement occasion, in L/min
oxygen content of arterial blood of each patient at each occasion, in mL O2 per dL
oxygen content of mixed venous blood of each patient at each occasion, in mL O2 per dL
oxygen consumption of each patient at each occasion measured from expired-gas analysis, in mL/min

claim: Among 60 mice, treated mice produce more peak twitch force than untreated mice of the same body mass: the difference between the group means of peak force, adjusted for body mass by analysis of covariance, is positive with a two-sided p-value below 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: peak twitch force of one hindlimb muscle of each mouse, in mN
body mass of each mouse, in g
True if the mouse received the treatment, False if it did not

claim: The postal district and the three covariates together predict the outcome y for new patients: the Pearson correlation between predicted and observed y is at least 0.25.

data_keys.meaning: True where the patient's home postal district is the district of that column
three continuous covariates per patient (age, body-mass index, systolic pressure)
continuous health outcome of each patient

claim: Gene-expression profiles distinguish the two leukaemia types in new samples: the area under the ROC curve is at least 0.90.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in each bone-marrow sample
True for acute myeloid leukaemia, False for acute lymphoblastic leukaemia

claim: In a field experiment, 10 plots were each surveyed at 30 quadrats and each quadrat was scored as occupied or not by a seaweed species; the array exclosure marks plots fenced against grazers. Claim: mean occupancy is higher in fenced plots than in open plots by at least 0.10, where the occupancy of a plot is the fraction of its quadrats that are occupied, and a one-sided test of the difference between the mean occupancy of fenced plots and that of open plots is significant at the 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: True if the species was present in that quadrat of that plot
True if the plot was fenced against grazers
